body:
Someone finally has the honest conversation about wanting more, and it goes better than expected.

They request the raise, confess the ambition, name the bigger life, and a mentor or ally answers with a why not.

With Jupiter sextile Lilith, the people with sponsorship and reach meet the want that never had a sponsor.

Somebody still has to make the introduction while both are in the room.

The moment may pass unused, but a want that people sponsor stops being a transgression and starts being a plan.
